items.distractor_fact: Stacja meteorologiczna w sąsiedniej miejscowości zanotowała tego ranka {D} °C.
items.gloss_en: The weather station in the neighboring town recorded {D} °C that morning.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a different place, a weather station in a neighboring town, not the location whose morning/afternoon readings the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Akcje innej spółki notowanej na tej samej giełdzie kosztowały tego dnia {D} zł.
items.gloss_en: Shares of a different company listed on the same exchange cost {D} zł that day.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a different company's stock, not the share price whose opening/closing the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Poziom wody w sąsiednim zbiorniku wynosił tego dnia {D} m.
items.gloss_en: The water level in the neighboring reservoir was {D} m that day.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a different reservoir, not the one whose morning/evening water level the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Inna przesyłka nadana tego samego dnia ważyła {D} kg.
items.gloss_en: A different parcel sent that same day weighed {D} kg.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a different parcel, not the one whose weight before/after the journey the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Inny klient miał na swoim koncie {D} zł.
items.gloss_en: A different customer had {D} zł in their own account.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a different customer's account, not the one whose deposit and spending the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Na innej lokacie, założonej w tym samym banku, zgromadzono {D} zł.
items.gloss_en: A different term deposit, opened at the same bank, held {D} zł.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a different term-deposit account, not the one whose deposit and withdrawal the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Inna firma z tej samej branży osiągnęła w tym miesiącu przychody w wysokości {D} zł.
items.gloss_en: A different company in the same industry earned revenue of {D} zł that month.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a different company's revenue, not the firm whose income and expenses the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Liczba goli zdobytych przez inną drużynę w tej samej lidze w tym sezonie wynosiła {D}.
items.gloss_en: The number of goals scored by a different team in the same league this season was {D}.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a different team, not the one whose goals scored and conceded the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Inny inwestor osiągnął w tym roku zyski w wysokości {D} zł.
items.gloss_en: A different investor made gains of {D} zł that year.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a different investor, not the one whose gains and losses the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Liczba uderzeń innego zawodnika na innym polu golfowym wynosiła {D}.
items.gloss_en: The number of strokes of a different player on a different golf course was {D}.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a different player on a different course whose par is not stated, so no second par subtraction is possible.

items.distractor_fact: Rzeczywisty czas przyjazdu innego pociągu na innej linii, liczony w minutach od północy, wynosił {D} min.
items.gloss_en: The actual arrival time of a different train on a different line, measured in minutes after midnight, was {D} min.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a different train on a different line; only its actual arrival is given, with no matching scheduled time stated, so no second delay subtraction is possible.

items.distractor_fact: W sąsiednim budynku winda zatrzymała się na piętrze oznaczonym numerem {D}.
items.gloss_en: In the neighboring building, the elevator stopped at the floor marked with the number {D}.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a different building's elevator, and no reference/ground-floor value is given for it, so no second floor-vs-reference subtraction is possible.

items.distractor_fact: Liczba bramek zdobytych przez inną drużynę, niebiorącą udziału w tym meczu, wynosiła {D}.
items.gloss_en: The number of goals scored by a different team, not involved in this match, was {D}.
items.entity_note: Belongs to a third team outside the Sokół-Orzeł match, with no second figure paired to it, so it cannot form another subtraction.
